mapper.select: select e.*, p.park_name, p.admin_id, u.user_name from enter e left join parking p on e.park_id = p.id left join user u on e.user_id = u.id where e.user_id=#{userId} and e.flag=#{flag} order by e.enter_time desc,e.id desc

select e.*, p.park_name, p.admin_id, u.user_name from enter e left join parking p on e.park_id = p.id left join user u on e.user_id = u.id where e.user_id=#{userId} and e.flag=#{flag} and reservation=#{reservation} order by e.enter_time desc,e.id desc
